title: Econoclast intake
description: What the agent understood from a free-text request, plus what to ask the user. Returned by the econoclast_intake MCP tool and agent/intake.py.

paper.description: a URL, file path, or title; empty if none given

data.description: a dataset path/URL the user supplied, or empty

claim.description: the specific result to stress-test, or empty

ask.description: a plain-language question for the user

ready.description: true if a paper is known and the run can proceed
